notes:
Summary: Colebrook is building a ticket-deflection / RAG-powered support assistant for a 24/7 SaaS product support org. Primary goal: increase automated deflection and shorten human handling time while keeping strict latency and top-N relevance guarantees.

Key context:
- Current stack: prototype with Pinecone + OpenAI embeddings + external reranker (endpoint) for top-5. Works functionally but cost per query ~ $0.18 and p95 retrieval+rerank ~ 420ms (unacceptable).
- Scale target: initial index 5M tickets (backlog + KB), plan to grow to ~20M docs within 12 months. Average doc length 500 tokens; many short (subject/summary) + long attachments.
- Workload profile: ~2k qps during peak (multi-tenant across product lines), typical queries need <150ms p95 for retrieval+rerank to preserve UI snappiness. Cost sensitivity: enterprise buyer but wants predictable unit economics; target <$0.03/query at scale.
- Quality targets: reranker must reliably include correct answer in top-5 with precision@5 >= 0.92 for labeled eval sets. They measure MRR and precision@1/5 on a 7k-example in-house eval.

Technical requirements discussed:
- Dense embeddings + approximate nearest neighbor for candidate generation; hybrid lexical + vector fallback for exact-match policies.
- Two-stage architecture: cheap dense retrieval for top-50 candidates -> lightweight reranker (smaller transformer) to produce top-5 -> optional expensive generator for long-form responses when needed.
- Strong interest in KV/prefix caching for hot queries and continuous batching to meet latency SLOs.
- Must support VPC/private control plane and KMS-managed keys; audit logs and retention controls mandatory.

POC plan & notes:
- Redwood proposal: Dedicated GPUs with optimized kernel selection, columnstore-like index for embeddings, reranking performed on-device with quantized 8-bit model. Suggested flow: Redwood embeddings (open LLM) -> approximate NN (sharded) -> on-host rerank model -> prefix cache.
- POC scope: 500k historical tickets + 100k live traffic shadowed, measure p95 retrieval+rerank, cost per query, precision@5. 3-week POC + 2-week ramp.
- Success metrics: p95 <= 150ms for retrieval+rerank at 500 qps shadow, cost <= $0.03/query (projected at 5M index), precision@5 >= 0.90 on their eval set.
